The agent's response does not use a table format at all - it uses bullet points and prose. Additionally, the response mixes ERROR-level findings with 'Warning-level highlights' (yellow status) in the same narrative, which violates the requirement to only include error/red status findings. While the content does cover account IDs, check descriptions, and resource counts for the ERROR items (security groups, IAM Access Analyzer, Lambda runtimes, ECR scanning, DMS exposure, Config disabled, Well-Architected flags), it also includes warning-level items that should have been excluded, and critically fails the structural requirement of being presented as a table with clear per-row account/check/count breakdown.</reasoning>
